semanticReview.method: Cotejo semántico directo con fuente primaria académica gratuita; afirmaciones reescritas para ajustarlas al texto, variedad, muestra y localizadores; APA 7 y Evidence canónica comprobadas con assessEntry.
findings: Gouveia (2010) classifies “Vamos cantar!” as an exhortative imperative: ir + infinitive has exhortative force and presents a suggestion that is both command and offer. The source concerns Portuguese generally and does not establish Brazilian frequency.
Localizador: pp. 21–22, § 4, Table 8 and discussion of “Vamos cantar!”; 676–713.

Referencia APA 7: Gouveia, C. A. M. (2010). Towards a profile of the interpersonal organization of the Portuguese clause. DELTA: Documentação e Estudos em Linguística Teórica e Aplicada, 26(1), 1–24. https://revistas.pucsp.br/delta/article/download/3562/2327
AssessEntry final: ok=true, claims=1/1, coverageComplete=true, citationReady=true.
limitations: Se eliminaron generalizaciones sobre frecuencia o variedad que la fuente no establecía.
